text:
jamal: PTAL — addressed the comments from yesterday. I added a dedicated test fixture for the concurrency edge case that caused the kvcache race, clarified the API contract in the README (no schema changes), and updated CHANGELOG. CI was flaky locally earlier but I fixed the race and pushed the change.

alex: thanks! quick Q: did you end up changing the request/response schema or just docs?

jamal: just docs and an optional field clarification. no breaking schema changes. example snippet in README: ```json
{
  "prompt": "...",
  "timeout_ms": 30000
}
```

maria: can you paste the failing trace you saw earlier so I can review the fix surface area?

jamal: pasted the minimal log we were getting locally: ```
ERROR: shard=2: kvcache: race detected, index out of range
stack: runtime.go:221 -> kvcache.go:137 -> kv_writer.go:45
```

jamal: fix is a small mutex around writes plus a unit test that reproduces concurrent writes in kvcache_test.go: ```go
func TestKVConcurrentWrites(t *testing.T) {
  // spawn goroutines that write the same key concurrently and assert no panic
}
```

ci-bot: build started for jamal/PR#3482 (linux, macos)

alex: lgtm with one tiny nit — can you rename TestKVConcurrentWrites to TestKVConcurrentWrites_NoNameClash (or similar) to avoid flakiness from other packages doing TestKVConcurrentWrites?

jamal: good call. renamed and pushed a squash.

ci-bot: build passed for jamal/PR#3482 — linux ✅ macos ✅. smoke tests passed. https://ci.internal/runs/3482

sara: PTAL when you have 5 — would like to queue this for canary tomorrow morning if green.

maria: glanced through changes, seems safe. behavior is explicit now and test covers the race. :thumbsup:

alex: +1 after the rename. assigning a merge owner?

jamal: thanks — pinging @merge-ops to pick a slot. PTAL folks.

merge-ops-bot: scheduled jamal/PR#3482 for canary window 2025-04-12 09:00 UTC (slot reserved)

jamal: noted. I'll monitor canary metrics during the window and have revert playbook ready. appreciate the quick eyes, everyone.

alex: thanks for the fast turnaround — I'll take merge ownership and watch the canary.

maria: thanks — marking as reviewed on my side.

jamal: closing the loop — if anything odd shows up in canary I'll post in #incidents and tag the oncall.
